newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: SAfrican prisoner shoots two, takes five hostage.
newsitem.headline: SAfrican prisoner shoots two, takes five hostage.

text.p: One of South Africa's most notorious criminals was on Monday night holding five people hostage at a prison near Port Elizabeth, a prison spokesman said.
Thembesile "Tyson" Makaluza, who is serving a 16-year sentence for armed robbery in St Albans prison, shot and wounded two warders before taking the five men prisoner.
"Negotiations with him (Makaluza) are continuing. He is a very dangerous man," the spokesman said.
One of the wounded warders managed to escape and alert prison authorities and was admitted to hospital with bullet wounds in his leg. The second was shot in the stomach and released by Makaluza.
